milestone: Immutable CPU String-array fields in records with recursive local-worker ownership

implementation.source: [String] fields, nested records/updates, contextual empty fields, field indexing/length/maps, captured whole records, record arrays/maps, imported helpers and local worker recovery
implementation.storage: Five-unit owned array descriptors; retain outer backing plus each managed String, recursively through records and record arrays; preserve immutable shared array/text identities
implementation.validation: Validate outer arrays and all UTF-8 cell descriptors; no result publication after malformed inputs, cancellation, admission failure or partial retention failure; settle acquired owners
implementation.parser: Treat an array literal after a dedented block expression as a new statement; regression coverage for parallel, conditional and catch blocks
implementation.limits: Nested arrays, String tensors, record-array fields, GPU Strings, whole-record CLI display, native distributed transport and public C/C++ interfaces remain gated/separate

coverage: Nested immutable updates, empty arrays/text, Unicode/NUL cells and shared text also held in scalar siblings
Array lengths 0, 1, 7 and 257; shared outer backing across fields; multiple rows and repeated observations; retained results after source and scheduler destruction
Record arrays/maps, nested lexical captures, numeric/Bool siblings, all six numeric families and imported helper-private nominal types
Malformed late cells, array stride/offset, scalar sibling and numeric sibling descriptors; output sentinels unchanged and partial owners settled
Partial owner allocation failure, cancellation, deadline, admission and scheduler allocation failure; cleanup counters balanced
TaskError recovery/rethrow and managed diagnostic text returned in an array field then passed to another worker
Frontend forged-IR rejections, fresh field-read lengths, five-unit layout budget, rejected-build artifact preservation
Documentation example compiled and executed in all four variants
Parser statement boundaries plus existing String arrays, scalar String fields, Bool-array fields, record arrays and semantics/continuation regressions
qualification.scope: Focused CPU qualification, not a full-suite or new GPU execution claim. Optimized applies to generated programs/harnesses using the existing runtime archive.
qualification.build_notes: No production edits after final focused qualification began. An earlier debug frontend test attempted unsupported whole-record-array CLI output; corrected the test to consume its length before final qualification. Existing relevant frontend executables freshly relinked.
